ensemble_design.kernel_pair_interpretation: weak-field matched candidate pair only; no nonperturbative radius equivalence asserted

familywise_inference.interval_rule: hull of the required block-length intervals
familywise_inference.failed_draw_rule: invalid required loop mean invalidates the paired draw; abstain if >1% invalid draws or precision gate fails

finite_T_Creutz.estimand: absolute finite-T chi_stout(R=2,T=5), not a ground-state force
finite_T_Creutz.loop_mean_rule: compute paired ensemble means first; take logs only for positive means

ground_state_discrete_static_force.estimand: absolute stout ground-state discrete static force at midpoint R=2.5
ground_state_discrete_static_force.reference_role: identity is an operator-overlap and shared-spectrum consistency check; the ground-state force difference is not the primary estimand

q_overlap_contract.operator_overlap_convention: Z_nk(R)=<n|O_k(R)|0> for the ordered bare smearing operator O_k
q_overlap_contract.fit_source: joint finite-Nt spectral fit to the measured 3x3 C_ij(R,t) matrix
q_overlap_contract.gevp_role: GEVP may initialize, label, and stress-test joint spectral fits; its single composite projected operator is separate and must not be copied into identity, APE, or stout kernel-indexed q cells
q_overlap_contract.scope: positive forward-spectrum q term only; finite-Nt backward/thermal, mixed-sector, fit-truncation, and interval-coverage bounds remain separate

finite_Nt_trace_decomposition.trace_formula: C_ij(R,T;N_t)=Z0(N_t)^-1 * sum_(m,n) exp[-eps_m*(N_t-T)] * exp[-V_n(R)*T] * A_i,mn(R) * conjugate(A_j,mn(R))

component_sectors.q: m=0,n>0: vacuum ground state with excited static-source states
component_sectors.h: m>0,n=0: excited vacuum-sector states with static-source ground state
component_sectors.x: m>0,n>0: excited states in both transfer-matrix sectors

finite_Nt_trace_decomposition.endpoint_convention: proposed time-local source/sink convention with constant endpoint factors absorbed into A; production exporter time origin and any insertion offsets require independent review
finite_Nt_trace_decomposition.positivity_assumption: q/h/x are nonnegative only under a positive transfer-matrix spectral representation and the stated endpoint factorization

contamination_stencil.rationale: T=5 and T+1=6 lie inside every selected fit window [tmin,7] for tmin=3,4,5
contamination_stencil.q_envelope: for each selected kernel and R, take the maximum over all tmin=3,4,5 and 2/3-state variants of sum_n overlap_ratio_upper[n]*exp(-gap_lower[n]*T); overlap_ratio_upper bounds |Z_nk/Z_0k|^2 for that bare basis operator
contamination_stencil.within_cell_interval_family: Bonferroni over 24 endpoint slots per q cell (6 fit variants x up to 2 excited states x 2 one-sided endpoints); 2-state variants use one excited state, unused slots are not reassigned, and alpha_endpoint=systematic_cell_alpha/24

relative_error_budget.reference: positive simultaneous lower confidence bound for f_reference is required; otherwise abstain

ground_state_discrete_static_force.error_propagation: use log(1+q+h+x) at the four stout R=2,3 and T=5,6 corners, then apply Delta_R Delta_t before the force-unit gate; identity corners are comparison diagnostics only

finite_T_Creutz.invalid_point_rule: invalidate a paired draw if any required loop mean is nonpositive or nonfinite; abstain if invalid fraction exceeds 0.01 or the precision gate fails
finite_T_Creutz.comparison_family: co-primary family with the separate ground_state_discrete_static_force lane; alpha allocated to this lane is 0.025

inference.interval_method: paired circular block bootstrap: 10000 draws; primary block length 5; report hull across lengths 2, 5, 10; coverage calibration remains open
inference.multiplicity_method: Bonferroni allocation across the two co-primary lanes

ground_state_discrete_static_force.reference_role: identity is an operator-overlap and shared-spectrum consistency check; the ground-state force difference is not the primary estimand

force_bound_propagation.assumption: q,h,x are nonnegative loop-level upper bounds and each correction is log(1+q+h+x)
force_bound_propagation.component_force_bound: sum over the four stout corners of log1p(component_bound)

spectral_bounds.scope: proposed 1.5% post-propagation absolute stout-force component budget; derive raw corner cap from the positive force-scale lower bound
proposed 1.5% post-propagation absolute stout-force component budget; derive raw corner cap from the positive force-scale lower bound
proposed 1.0% post-propagation absolute stout-force component budget; derive raw corner cap from the positive force-scale lower bound

systematic_bounds.scope: force-unit component bound after propagation through the four stout loop corners
